## Phase summary (generated by the gatekeeper agent)

In Discover, the team framed a testable problem hypothesis for solo freelance web/UI designers and drafted four alternative concepts. Concept scoring was completed, selecting C0 with a 45/70 rating. A market model was drafted using desk research, noting a largest verified community of 201,716 members but zero independent relevant discussions in the past 24 months. A Mom Test interview kit with 12 questions and five recruiting sources was prepared, though no interview data has been collected yet. Founder overrides on market definition and interview steps mean those outputs remain untested.

**Assumptions confirmed:**

- There exists a sizable community of freelance designers (≈201k members)
- Concept scoring methodology can rank alternatives

**Assumptions killed:**

- The problem is actively discussed in existing designer communities (0 relevant discussions found)

**Still open:**

- Validated market size and segment demand
- Customer interview results to confirm pain points and willingness to pay
- Actual interest and adoption potential for the selected concept C0
